headline: This law names a New Jersey post office after First Lieutenant Salvatore S. Corma II.
what_it_does: The law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1265 Hurffville Road in Deptford Township, New Jersey. The building will be officially called the "First Lieutenant Salvatore S. Corma II Post Office Building." It is an honorary designation and does not change postal services or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 13, 2016.
